newsitem.headline: TABLE - Jenny Craig Q4 results.

text.p: ($ in thousands, except per share data)
Twelve Months Ended Three Months Ended

NOTE: Operating income for the fourth quarter of fiscal 1997 was $7.2 million, including a net $3.5 million received from one of its insurance carriers to settle litigation. Operating income was $12.0 million for the same quarter in fiscal 1996.

Net income was $4.7 million, or $.22 per share, for the quarter ended June 30, 1997 and, before the cumulative effect of a recent change in accounting method, was $8.3 million, or $.40 per share, for the year ended June 30, 1997. This compared to net income of $7.8 million, or $.36 per share, for the quarter ended June 30, 1996 and $22.9 million, or $.95 per share, for the year ended June 30, 1996. In June 1997, the Company changed its method of accounting for service fees received from customers, effective July 1, 1996. The Company adopted the new method of accounting, which recognizes service revenues on a level basis, to more closely conform with evolving accounting trends. This change did not have a material effect on 1997 operating income. The cumulative effect after taxes of this change in accounting method was a reduction in net income for fiscal 1997 of $7.5 million, or $.36 per share.
